plugins.name: git-init-repo
plugins.description: Safely connects a local git repo to a new remote and does the first push.

plugins.name: dumbass
plugins.description: Use when you don't understand what the agent said.

plugins.name: architect
plugins.description: Use when asked to analyze, audit, design or redesign how a codebase or subsystem is structured. State ownership, duplicated ways of doing a task, coupling between modules, or 'workarounds keep piling up'.

plugins.name: explain
plugins.description: Use when asked 'how does X work' type questions. If the scope is ambiguous, state your interpretation and explore. The user can redirect.
